name: Summer Sports Experience and "Kids in Motion" Programming: 2022 to current
description: This dataset records summer sports programming and "Kids in Motion" sessions run at New York City parks and playgrounds from 2022 to the present. Each row represents a scheduled session and includes the borough, the specific park or playground, the date and time, the sport played, the program type (K.I.M for Kids in Motion or S.S.E for Summer Sports Experience), attendance, and any cancellation reason. The data covers five boroughs and 161 locations, with sports including basketball, flag football, soccer, pickleball, and mixed "Various Sports" sessions. Attendance ranges from 0 to over 1,500 participants per session, and cancellations are logged for reasons such as bad weather, staff call-outs, or reassignment to other events. The dataset can be used to analyze attendance trends by borough, sport, or program type; compare the reach of Kids in Motion versus Summer Sports Experience; study how often and why sessions are cancelled; and support planning and resource allocation for recreation
